text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Handkerchief check. Tools are ready too. 
And today's guest of honor, Tsurumaru-san, 
is here—alright!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we head out? To 
Tsuru-chan's commemorative birthday 
fishing trip.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't be so tense. Tsurumaru-san, 
you're a beginner at fishing, right?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, it'll be fine. Even if we 
catch nothing, King says she'll prepare a 
delicious feast for us~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
B-But, still! Since the two of you went 
out of your way to invite me, I'm gonna 
give it everything I've got and totally 
shine!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I'm always just watching the two of them 
from behind. If only for today, I want to 
perform just as well and stand beside 
them...!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The secret to fishing is taking it easy 
and relaxing. If you're burning with too 
much hype, you'll just scare the fish 
away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right. No rushing, no panicking, 
just relax your shoulders. Side by side 
with your neighbor... okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. While we relax, we can 
let our conversation blossom too. Shall we 
enjoy ourselves side-by-side today...?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
! Standing side by side, chatting... I 
see. Ehehe... Sounds nice, that could be 
fun too!
